name: dhi
description: Personal document Q&A over a local folder of PDFs, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, TXT, MD, CSV, and RTF files organized into topic subfolders. Semantically indexes documents -- including embedded images via vision -- into a local SQLite index (no cloud embedding service, no paid API) and answers questions strictly from that content, always citing document + page/section + topic, saying "I don't know" when the documents don't cover it.
